# goslop text fixture — PERF-PY-23 seed_plans migration loop (not hot path)
lang: python
file: app/billing/storage.py
---
import json

PLAN_DEFINITIONS = []


class Storage:
    def seed_plans(self) -> None:
        for plan in PLAN_DEFINITIONS:
            features_json = json.dumps(list(plan.features), separators=(",", ":"))
            self.execute(features_json)
